LanguageData.CC_Settings_VisitorsIdle_Tip: When visitors would otherwise stand about or wander near their spot, they do something of their own now and then: talk with each other or keep one of your colonists company, sit by a fire or on a bench, warm their hands in the cold, get out of the rain, eat from their own packs, nap under a tree at midday, play your games and instruments or use your telescope when none of your people want them, look at your art, pray at a shrine of their god, see to their own animals, smoke or drink something of their own, smoke a pipe or whittle; their children run about and play. What they do depends on their people's tech level, the hour and the weather. None of it is work for the colony and none of your goods are used. They reserve nothing, and they get up as soon as one of your colonists heads for the game, the seat or the place. The game's visitors and traders, Rimfolk's visits between their duties and envoys do this; Hospitality's guests only for what Hospitality has no recreation for. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_VisitorsIdle: Visitors sit, talk, play and see to their animals instead of standing about.
